params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs: The Replace All Repository Topics operation is a PUT request to the GitHub Repos API endpoint /repos/{owner}/{repo}/topics that allows you to completely replace the existing list of topics associated with a specific repository. Unlike adding or removing individual topics, this operation overwrites all current topics with the new set provided in the request body.
